build.heading: Itqan answers four questions, in the order they matter.

steps.title: Where you stand today
steps.body: Upload whatever you already have and Itqan reads it, then tells you what it adds up to in the words employers are actually using.

steps.title: Which role to aim for
steps.body: If you already know the job you want, name it. If you do not, Itqan shows you the roles your background is closest to right now.

steps.title: The shortest path there
steps.body: The courses that close the gap between the two, ordered so the ones that move you furthest come first.

steps.title: The jobs you can apply to now
steps.body: Openings that are live today and actually match, each one carrying the reason it fits and a link to where it came from.

build.link: How it works, step by step

openEdge.heading: This is what a real match looks like, in full.
openEdge.body: Itqan shows you what you already have, what the role is asking for, and the reason behind every line of it. Anything it cannot evidence stays flagged for you to confirm rather than quietly filled in.
openEdge.roleLabel: What a Junior Data Analyst opening asks for
openEdge.note: An illustrative example. Inside Itqan, every skill links to the opening it was read from, with the date it was found.

items.a: The parts that get you started are free and they stay free: where you stand, your path, your three strongest job matches and the advisor. Premium opens the rest of the matches you fit and raises how much of the AI you can use.

items.q: What do you need from me?
items.a: Whatever you already have, whether that is a CV, a set of certificates or an academic record. The more Itqan can read, the sharper the match it can make.

items.q: Do you find real jobs, or just give advice?
items.a: Real openings that are live right now, each one with the reason it fits you. Itqan does not promise you a job, it helps you improve your chances of getting one.

items.q: What if I do not know what job I want?
items.a: That is where most people start, and it is the first thing Itqan works on. You end up choosing between real options instead of guessing at them.

closing.heading: Find out where you actually stand.
closing.body: It takes a name, an email and a password. That is the whole sign up.

hiw.title: How Itqan works
hiw.metaDescription: Four steps from what you already have to the shortest path to the job you want.
hiw.intro: Four steps, and there is no magic hidden in any of them.

steps.title: You bring what you already have
steps.body: A CV, your certificates, an academic record, whatever exists. Not a form with twenty empty fields waiting for you.

steps.title: Itqan tells you where you stand
steps.body: It shows you everything it read, exactly as it read it, and you correct anything that is wrong. A position you checked yourself is worth more than one you were handed.

steps.title: You choose the role to aim for
steps.body: If you know it, say so. If you do not, Itqan suggests the roles your background already supports and you pick from real options.

steps.title: You get the path and the jobs
steps.body: The courses that close the distance, in order, and the openings you can apply to today. Each one carries its reason and a source you can open yourself.

proof.title: Proof
proof.metaDescription: Real screens from inside Itqan: the confirmation step that pauses the run, and job matches carrying their reason and their source.
proof.heading: Do not take our word for any of it.
proof.intro: These are real screens from inside Itqan rather than pictures of what it might look like. Judge the mechanism for yourself before you create an account.

limits.heading: What Itqan cannot do yet
items: It cannot promise you a job. The applying is still yours.
It has not published an accuracy figure, because measurement on enough real cases is not finished. A number before that would be a guess.
Some results are suggestions to confirm, not facts. They are labelled.
What you upload is a starting point, not the whole picture of you.
It reads Arabic and English. Other languages, not yet.

confirm.heading: Itqan stops and waits for you.
confirm.body: It reads your documents and then pauses. Everything it extracted is put in front of you with the place it was read from and how sure it is, and anything it could not evidence is marked for you to confirm rather than quietly kept. This screen is the only thing that decides what the rest of the product believes about you, and you are the one filling it in.
confirm.caption: The confirmation step, part way through onboarding.

match.heading: Every match carries its reason and its source.
match.body: A recommendation is a chain with three links: where you stand, what the role asks for, and a posting that asks for it right now. Itqan shows the whole chain under the name why this match, points at the thing in your own documents that caused it, and links out to the live posting with the date it was found. When one link is weaker it says so instead of rounding up.
match.caption: Job matches, each with why this match and a dated source.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: How Itqan collects, uses, discloses and retains personal data, and the rights available to you.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy governs the collection, use, disclosure, transfer and retention of personal data by Itqan. It forms part of the agreement between you and us, and it applies whenever you access our website or use our services. By creating an account you consent to the practices described below.

sections.heading: 1. Scope and the controller
points: Itqan operates a career navigation service through which individuals may assess their professional standing, identify target roles, obtain recommendations for training, and review employment opportunities. In relation to the personal data described in this Policy, Itqan acts as the controller and determines the purposes and means of its processing. Itqan is established in the Sultanate of Oman and its processing of personal data is subject to the laws of the Sultanate, and in particular to the Personal Data Protection Law and its Executive Regulations. The competent supervisory authority is the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology.
This Policy applies to all users of the service and should be read together with our Terms of Use. Capitalised expressions not defined in this Policy carry the meaning given to them in those Terms.

sections.heading: 2. Personal data we collect
points: We collect the data you supply when you register, namely your full name, your email address and the password you select, together with a telephone number and a profile image where you elect to provide them. We further collect the documents you submit to the service, which typically comprise a curriculum vitae and may include academic transcripts, certificates and comparable records, whether uploaded as files or captured as photographs of physical documents.

From those documents we derive a structured professional record consisting of your skills, your educational history, your employment history, your projects and your certifications. We additionally collect the objectives and preferences you state within the service, the content of your exchanges with the assistant made available inside the product, and a record of your consumption of the service measured against the limits of your subscription.

We receive certain technical data automatically when you access the service, including your internet protocol address, the type and version of your browser, and the pages you request. We do not receive, process or store payment card details at any time; those are collected and processed exclusively by our payment processor.

sections.heading: 3. Special categories of personal data
points: We do not request, and our systems provide no means of recording, data revealing religion, marital status, nationality, gender, date of birth or ethnic origin. No such category forms part of the professional record we derive from your documents, and no such category is used in the generation of any recommendation or match.

You should nonetheless be aware that where a document you submit contains information of that nature within its text, that text is transmitted, in the ordinary course of extraction, to the providers described in clause 6. Such information is not retained by us, does not enter your professional record and is not used for any purpose. Images of your documents are not transmitted to any such provider in any circumstances, and character recognition, where required, is performed on infrastructure under our control.

sections.heading: 4. Purposes of processing and lawful basis
points: We process personal data in order to provide the service you have requested. That includes assessing your professional standing, identifying roles consistent with your record and stated objectives, compiling recommendations for training and certification, and presenting employment opportunities matched to your record. We further process personal data in order to administer your account, to communicate with you in connection with the service, to apply and enforce the limits of your subscription, to detect and prevent misuse, and to comply with obligations to which we are subject.

The lawful basis for this processing is your consent, obtained at registration by an affirmative act which is not pre-selected and without which an account cannot be created. We record the version of this Policy presented to you at the time consent was given. Consent may be withdrawn at any time in accordance with clause 9, and withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before it.
Consent to receive marketing communications is obtained separately and is not comprised within the consent given at registration.

sections.heading: 5. Automated processing
points: The service relies upon automated processing to read submitted documents, derive the professional record, identify suitable roles and compile recommendations. The matching of an individual to a role constitutes profiling within the meaning of applicable data protection law.

No result of that processing is applied until you have reviewed it. A confirmation stage is presented following extraction, at which the derived record is displayed to you together with its source and an indication of confidence, and at which you may amend or remove any element. No subsequent stage of processing occurs until that stage is completed. Any element which cannot be substantiated is presented as provisional and requires your confirmation.
You may object to automated processing and request that a decision be reviewed by a natural person by contacting us at the address in clause 14.

sections.heading: 6. Disclosure to service providers
points: We engage a limited number of service providers to perform functions on our behalf, namely the hosting of our infrastructure and stored data, the provision of artificial intelligence processing used for extraction and for the assistant, the delivery of transactional electronic mail, and the processing of payments. Each such provider processes personal data solely on our instructions and for the purpose for which it was engaged, and each is bound by obligations of confidentiality and security.

We do not sell personal data. We do not disclose personal data for advertising purposes, and we do not permit any provider to use personal data disclosed to it for the development or improvement of its own products or models.

We may disclose personal data where required to do so by law, by order of a competent court, or at the lawful request of a public authority, and where necessary to establish, exercise or defend a legal claim.

sections.heading: 7. Transfer outside the Sultanate of Oman
points: Personal data collected through the service is stored and processed outside the Sultanate of Oman, including in jurisdictions within Asia, Europe and North America. Such transfer is carried out on the basis of your consent, given at registration and capable of withdrawal.

Transfer does not discharge our obligations. We remain responsible for ensuring that each recipient affords personal data a standard of protection no lower than that required by the laws of the Sultanate of Oman, and we impose that standard by contract upon each provider we engage.

sections.heading: 8. Retention
points: Personal data is retained for so long as your account subsists, in order that the record and history associated with your account remain available to you. You may delete an individual document at any time through the service, and such deletion removes both the record of the document and the underlying file.

Where you request the erasure of your account, we will erase the account and the personal data associated with it. Copies contained within backup media are removed as those media are superseded in the ordinary cycle of rotation, and are not retrieved or used in the interim.

sections.heading: 9. Rights of the data subject
points: You are entitled to obtain confirmation of whether we process personal data relating to you and to be provided with a copy of that data; to require the correction of data which is inaccurate or incomplete; to require the erasure of your data; to receive your data in a structured and commonly used format capable of transmission to another party; to withdraw your consent, whereupon further processing shall cease; and to object to processing carried out by automated means and to request review by a natural person.

A request to exercise any of these rights may be made to the address in clause 14 and will be answered within thirty days of receipt. Where we are unable to give effect to a request in whole or in part, we will inform you of the reason. Nothing in this Policy limits your right to lodge a complaint with the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology.

sections.heading: 10. Security
points: We apply technical and organisational measures appropriate to the nature of the personal data we hold. Passwords are stored as irreversible cryptographic hashes and are not recoverable by us. Session credentials are inaccessible to scripts executing in your browser and are transmitted only over encrypted connections. Access to production systems is restricted to those personnel whose duties require it.

No method of transmission or storage is entirely secure, and we do not warrant absolute security. Where a breach of personal data occurs which is likely to affect you, we will notify you and the supervisory authority without undue delay, and our notification will describe the nature of the breach and the measures taken in response.

sections.heading: 11. Cookies
points: We place two cookies. The first maintains your authenticated session and is strictly necessary for the operation of the service. The second records the language you have selected. We do not place advertising cookies, we do not permit third party tracking, and we do not employ analytics which follow you beyond our website.

sections.heading: 12. Minors
points: The service is available only to persons who have attained the age of eighteen years. We do not knowingly establish an account for any person below that age. Where we become aware that an account has been established in contravention of this clause, we will close the account and erase the personal data associated with it.

sections.heading: 13. Amendment of this Policy
points: We may amend this Policy from time to time. Where an amendment is material we will notify you before it takes effect and, where the law so requires, we will obtain your consent afresh. The version of this Policy to which you consented is recorded against your account, and the version in force is identified by the date stated at the head of this document.

sections.heading: 14. Contact and complaints
points: Any enquiry concerning this Policy, and any request to exercise a right under clause 9, may be addressed to privacy@tryitqan.com.

Where you consider that our processing of your personal data does not comply with applicable law, you are entitled to lodge a complaint with the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology in the Sultanate of Oman.

terms.metaDescription: The agreement governing your use of Itqan, including the scope of the service, subscriptions, liability and termination.
terms.intro: These Terms of Use constitute a binding agreement between you and Itqan governing your access to and use of our website and services. By creating an account, or by otherwise accessing the service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not accept them, you must not use the service.

sections.heading: 1. The agreement and its scope
points: These Terms, together with our Privacy Policy, comprise the entire agreement between you and Itqan in respect of the service and supersede any prior understanding relating to its subject matter. In these Terms, references to Itqan, we and us are references to the operator of the service, and references to you are references to the person accessing it.

The service comprises a career navigation platform through which you may assess your professional standing, identify target roles, obtain recommendations for training and certification, and review employment opportunities published by third parties.

sections.heading: 2. Eligibility
points: You may use the service only if you have attained the age of eighteen years and are capable of entering into a binding contract. You warrant that the information you supply upon registration is accurate and complete and that you will maintain it as such.

An account is personal to the holder. You may not permit another person to use your account, and you may not establish an account on behalf of another person without that person's knowledge and authority.

sections.heading: 3. Your account and its security
points: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity occurring under your account, whether or not authorised by you. You must select a password which you do not use in connection with any other service, and you must notify us without delay upon becoming aware of any unauthorised access.
We may require verification of your email address before some or all of the service is made available to you.

sections.heading: 4. Nature of the service
points: The service provides information, assessment and recommendations. It does not constitute an offer of employment, a representation as to the availability of any position, or advice of a professional, legal or immigration character.

Itqan is not an employer, a recruitment agency or an employment intermediary, and does not act as your agent. We do not submit applications on your behalf, we are not party to any relationship between you and any employer, and we exercise no control over the conduct of any employer or training provider whose material is presented through the service.

We give no undertaking that use of the service will result in employment, in an interview, in a response to any application, or in any other outcome. Information concerning visas, sponsorship or entitlement to work is derived from the sources to which we link and must be verified by you with the competent authority.

sections.heading: 5. Automated output and your obligation to verify
points: Material parts of the service are produced by automated systems, including the reading of submitted documents, the derivation of your professional record, the matching of roles and the compilation of recommendations. Such systems are not free from error, and an error arising at an early stage may affect subsequent stages.

You acknowledge that the confirmation stage presented following extraction forms part of the service and that you are responsible for reviewing and correcting the derived record at that stage. You further acknowledge that you must verify any information before acting upon it, and in particular that you must confirm the terms of any position with the employer concerned and the terms of any course with the provider concerned before incurring expenditure or committing time.

sections.heading: 6. Your content
points: You retain all rights in the documents and other material you submit to the service. Nothing in these Terms operates to transfer ownership of that material to us.

You grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to store, reproduce, process and analyse the material you submit, for the sole purpose of providing the service to you and for the duration of your account. You warrant that you are entitled to submit the material and that its submission infringes no right of any other person.

Output generated for you, including your derived professional record, your recommended pathway and your matches, is yours to use. The service itself, together with its software, design, structure and underlying systems, remains our property and no right in it is granted to you other than the limited right of use conferred by these Terms.

sections.heading: 7. Acceptable use
points: You must not submit any document belonging to another person, nor represent as your own any qualification or experience which is not. You must not attempt to obtain access to any account or data other than your own, nor attempt to circumvent the limits applicable to your subscription or to obtain material which your subscription does not include.

You must not extract, reproduce, resell or redistribute the employment or training data presented through the service, whether by automated means or otherwise. You must not use the service in contravention of any applicable law, for the harassment of any person, or for the transmission of malicious code, and you must not take any step which impairs or is intended to impair the operation of the service or the infrastructure upon which it depends.

sections.heading: 8. Subscriptions and charges
points: The service is offered on a free plan and on a paid plan. The free plan includes an assessment of your professional standing, your recommended pathway, access to the assistant, and your three strongest employment matches maintained on a current basis, together with one document reassessment each week and thirty messages each day. The paid plan includes all available matches, three document reassessments each week and ninety messages each day.

The paid plan is charged at 2.9 Omani Rials per month. As the payment facility available to us does not support settlement in Omani Rials, the corresponding amount is charged in United States Dollars at 7.50.
We may vary the composition of either plan or the charges applicable to it. Where we do so, we will give you notice before the variation takes effect, and you may cancel in accordance with clause 9.

sections.heading: 9. Payment, renewal and cancellation
points: Charges are collected by our payment processor. We do not receive or retain your payment card details at any time.

A paid subscription renews automatically at the end of each monthly period until cancelled. You may cancel at any time, whereupon your access to the paid plan continues until the expiry of the period for which payment has been made and the account thereafter reverts to the free plan. No content is deleted upon reversion.

Charges paid in respect of a period which has commenced are not refundable, save where a refund is required by applicable law. You are responsible for any charge levied by your bank or card issuer in respect of currency conversion.

sections.heading: 10. Availability and variation of the service
points: We will use reasonable endeavours to maintain the availability of the service, but we do not undertake that it will be available without interruption or free from fault. We may modify, suspend or discontinue any part of the service, and where such a change is material and affects you we will give notice of it.
Parts of the service depend upon facilities provided by others, and an interruption affecting those facilities may affect the service.

sections.heading: 11. Suspension and termination
points: You may cease to use the service at any time and may request the erasure of your account in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We may suspend or terminate your access where you are in breach of clause 7, where your use of the service is unlawful, or where your use places the service or other users at risk. Where it is reasonable in the circumstances to do so, we will give you notice and an opportunity to remedy the breach before taking such action.
Clauses 4, 5, 6, 12, 13, 14, 17 and 18 survive termination of this agreement, together with any other provision which by its nature is intended to survive.

about.title: Who we are
about.metaDescription: Why we built Itqan. We show you where you stand, the shortest path to the job you want, and the real jobs that fit you today.
about.whyHeading: Nobody ever tells you how far away it is.
about.whyBody: You have a rough idea of where you want to end up. Nobody gives you the distance, and you should be able to see it from the first day.
about.mission: We show you where you stand, the shortest path to the job you want, and the jobs that fit you today.
about.vision: A world where nobody has to guess their next step.
about.how1Title: We measure against the real market.
about.how1Body: Live demand across MENA and what those openings ask for today, not a generic checklist.
about.how2Body: Every recommendation carries its reason and a real source you can open.
about.how3Body: No employer can buy a place in what you see.
about.evidenceBody: Roughly two thirds had read a job posting and could not tell whether something they had done counted as the skill being asked for. Nearly nine in ten were blocked by postings demanding experience they did not have. Nearly half of those rejected could not say why.
about.evidenceQualifier: An early sample, drawn from the graduates we are launching to. We are widening it.
about.whereBody: We are embedded at UTAS, our first pilot and where the survey came from. We start in Oman, then Saudi Arabia, then the wider region.
about.payHeading: What you will never pay for.
about.payBody: Where you stand, your path, your three strongest job matches and the advisor are free and stay free. Premium opens the rest of your matches and raises how much of the AI you can use, never the parts that get you started.
about.refuse1: We will not sell a place in your results.
about.refuse2: We will not invent a course or a job that does not exist.
about.refuse3: We do not promise you a job, we only help you increase your chances of getting it.
about.refuse4: We will not publish an accuracy figure we have not measured.

pricing.heading: Start for free.
pricing.intro: Everything that gets you moving costs nothing: where you stand, your path to the role you want, your three strongest job matches, and Hud. Premium opens the rest of the list and triples what you can ask of the AI.

faq.q: Do I have to pay to find a job?
faq.a: No. Your three strongest matches are free, and they are the ones worth your time first. Premium is for working through the rest of the list.

faq.q: What happens if I stop paying?
faq.a: Your account goes back to free. Nothing you have done is deleted, and your three strongest matches keep updating.
